brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reports that hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in Gaza remain displaced in worn-out tents and makeshift shelters following the destruction of residential neighborhoods during Israeli military operations. Repeated displacement orders have prevented residents from returning to their homes, forcing prolonged stays in inadequate temporary housing.

The displaced population faces increasingly harsh living conditions and deprivation of basic life essentials, the rights group said. The Centre for Human Rights characterizes the pattern of forced displacement and denial of return as indicative of a systematic plan to permanently displace Palestinians from the Gaza Strip.
dek: Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians in the Gaza Strip continue to live in worn-out tents and makeshift shelters following the destruction of their residential neighborhoods and their forced displacement as a result of Israeli military operations and repeated displacement orders. Displaced Gazans are facing increasingly harsh living conditions, deprived of the right to return to.
title: Hundreds of thousands in Gaza live in makeshift shelters after displacement.
